read.thesis: JPMorgan's Q4 CY25 read is supply-neutral: no capacity to cut in a bank, but 2026 expenses rise to about $105B and the CET1 ratio fell to 14.5% on the Apple Card RWA, while card NCO guidance sits at about 3.4%.
